trans-unit.source: On a device where you are already signed in, open this link and enter the pairing code shown here. Only approve a request you started.
Request permission to set up a new sign-in method. Approval comes from a different session where you are already signed in.
Waiting for approval on your other device.
Approved. Continue to set up a replacement sign-in method.
This request has already been used.
Only approve a request you started. Approval allows a replacement sign-in method to be created for your account.
This request is no longer waiting for approval.
Open the review link shown on the requesting device.
Your verified email helps you recover access. Changing it requires a recent identity check.
Enter the code sent to your new email address.
A new code has been requested. Check your email.
The change was saved, but the notification could not be sent.
Your account is created. Verify your email to finish signing in.
Request a new code to continue verifying this email.
Link Google as another sign-in method. Linking or removing it requires a recent identity check.
Google sign-in is not available right now. You can manage your other sign-in methods in Security.
Google is linked to your account.
Unlink Google and end sessions using it? Keep another working sign-in method.
Verify your email to finish continuing with Google.
This step could not be restored. Start again to request a new verification.
Your account. Your choice of how to sign in.
Your session changed or could not be checked. Return to sign in to continue.
You are signed in. Manage your account and choose how you access it.
This page is not available. You can return to your account or sign in.
Add a passkey or give an existing one a name you recognize. Removing a passkey ends sessions using it.
You have no passkeys yet. Add one to sign in with your device's screen lock.
Remove this passkey and end sessions using it? You must keep another working sign-in method.
Choose how you want to sign in. Your passkey can use your device's screen lock.
We could not connect to authentication. Check your connection and try again.
Create a passkey, then verify your email. No password to remember.
Create an account with a password
Choose a password, then verify your email.
After your password, we will ask for a code to confirm it is you.
Use 12–128 characters. Spaces and passphrases are welcome.
Adding or changing a password requires a recent identity check. Password sign-in always includes a second step.
Remove your password? Sessions using it will end. Keep another working sign-in method.
If this email can be used for recovery, we will send a code. Additional verification may be required.
Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password to continue.
If you enabled an authenticator, include its code or a backup code. Email alone cannot replace it.
Enter the code sent to your email.
Enter a code from your authenticator app, or use a backup code.
Your recovery proof allows you to set up a replacement sign-in method. Complete its verification before entering your account.
Confirm the replacement password with the required second factor. You can use a backup code instead of an authenticator code.
If the email does not arrive, start again and enter your replacement password to request a new code.
Switch between authenticator and backup code
Your replacement passkey is created. Sign in with that passkey to finish recovery.
Use a device where you are signed in
Only need to reset your password?
Enter your email code. If you enabled an authenticator, also include an authenticator or backup code.
Use an existing sign-in method before changing your account's security. You will review the change again afterwards.
Choose how you sign in and manage access to your account.
Use your device's screen lock or a security key.
Review and end access from your signed-in sessions.
Keep your recovery email up to date.
Review when sessions started and how they signed in. Device details and locations are not collected.
End every other session? They will need to sign in again.
End this session? If it is your current session, you will be signed out.
This verification can no longer continue. Sign out and start recovery again.
The request was cancelled or no credential was selected. Try again or choose another method.
Passkeys are not available in this browser or at this address. Choose another sign-in method.
Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
Your session changed. Try the action again.
This change is not available. Keep at least one working sign-in method and refresh your account before trying again.
We could not verify these details. Check them and try again. If the request expired, start again.
We could not complete this action. Try again or choose another method.
Existing backup codes cannot be displayed again. You can create a replacement set after confirming your identity.
Replace all existing codes? The old set will stop working immediately.
Save these codes somewhere safe. Each works once, and this set will not be shown again. Creating another set invalidates these codes.
An authenticator adds a code to password sign-in. Keep your backup codes safe in case you lose access to the app.
Or enter this manual key in your authenticator:
Disable your authenticator and invalidate its backup codes? Password sign-in will use email verification.
Authenticator setup is not available right now.
Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the manual key below.
The QR code could not be displayed. Use the manual key below.
